name: Clothmaking Unlocks at Science Level 3
description: **Cannot be ticked with No Fishing at Science Level 2: ticking one unticks the other.** Makes cloth, and so the fishing nets, come later; off by default. The Clothing Hut appears at Science level 2 as normal, but until Science level 3 (70,000 tech points) a villager dropped on the vines says "Don't know what to do with these tough vines!" and makes no cloth. Cloth the village already has can still be used: the fishing nets are mended with it and the Clothing Hut gives clothes as before. Nothing else changes.
behavior_changes: The vines' drop handler 0x436D40: with the Clothing Hut finished and Science below 3, the stock refusal "Don't know what to do with these tough vines!" (0x249) instead of the cloth start (action 0x7A); at Science 3 the stock cloth start.
explicit_non_changes: The Clothing Hut's site (Science 2), its building, cloth bolts already in the store, the fishing nets' use of them, clothes and every other drop are unchanged; nothing but this drop starts cloth-making.
Two guarded in-place edits: one jump and int3 padding after the handler; no executable tail space.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the drop at Science 1, 2 and 3 with the Clothing Hut finished and unfinished is emulated stock and patched in tests/test_vv4_clothmaking_at_science_3.py; runtime/player confirmation pending

patches.purpose: the Clothing Hut finished test's jump (0x436D86): to the Science check 0x436DB4
the Science check in the padding (0x436DB4): below 3 the stock refusal 0x436D88, else the stock cloth start 0x436D9F
